notes.title: Update:"LingTian1" Changed to Static Images and More
notes.content:
[h2]Main Updates for Otome Game Series "1000 Princes":[/h2]

[h3]1. "LingTian1" Changed to Static Images[/h3]
Both the demo and full versions of the game originally featured short dynamic video clips. However, due to each clip being under 1 second and looping repeatedly, they caused severe screen jitter, leading to poor visual feedback from players. As a result, all 1,050 MP4-format video clips in "LingTian1" have been converted into static images.

Originally, the video length, frame rate, and size were deliberately reduced to meet Google Play's AAB size limit. This compromise negatively affected visual quality. Moving forward, I will focus on enhancing the quality of static images in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/5d15b2207d21c725116369a470cb71fe3f5ee3c9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/fc21ea0b4697ce738c2c3ffcea16fabbcfd9c763.png[/img]

[quote=author]
[h3]What's the Difference Between "LingTian1" Demo and the "LingTian" Clips in "1000 Princes"?[/h3]
Both versions allow players to experience part of the gameplay. The "LingTian1" demo provides a continuous portion of the game—from Chapter 1 to Chapter X—with complete story progression, branching options, and full functionality.

On the other hand, the "LingTian1" clips in the shared route of "1000 Princes" feature disconnected romantic scenes from the game. These clips are not continuous, and option buttons do not display branching storylines.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/3a54e4bfa060c6ca691f0177ce1a8fe5cb36f2fc.png[/img]
[/quote]

[h3]2. Icon Update[/h3]
To make games easier to identify, I've updated the icons. For example, "LingTian1" now features a solo portrait of the prince. His name, such as "LingTian", is displayed at the bottom of the icon in the game's main UI color. The top right corner features a sequence tag like "1". If it's a demo version, a green diagonal ribbon appears on the top left.

The "1000 Princes" game, which serves as the shared storyline for all the princes and the player, has a group photo icon featuring multiple princes. The bottom label reads "1000 + Crown", and the background is rainbow-colored, representing the union of all princes. The top right corner includes a rainbow sequence tag. Demo versions have a green ribbon on the top left.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/973fc66051b920160e335696644106e1c0b98c63.png[/img]

notes.title: Listen to Music with Prince Ling Tian! ‘LingTian1’ Music Album!
notes.content:
Listen to Music with Prince Ling Tian! “LingTian1” Music Album!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/fd9e2a14b817f9d7e1bb4ff6a214b10afaa6582e.jpg[/img]  
My dear princess, I am Ling Tian! How was your day today? I brought a gift for you, and I can’t wait for you to listen—this “LingTian1” music album, just for you and me.  

Now, let me lead you into the music room. There’s excellent sound equipment here—please sit on the sofa and enjoy the beautiful melodies with me! By the way, there’s fruit juice and desserts on the table. Let’s have snacks while we listen! As long as I’m with you, every day is the most beautiful song.  

These tracks are also in the in‑game “LingTian1” music room playlist, but you can listen here directly—it’s more convenient, right? I asked composers and singers to create love songs for the one I adore—you—to express my love. I believe these melodies and lyrics convey my heart’s voice perfectly. Can you feel it?  

The MVs use scenes from our romance game as visuals. Now, let’s listen to the “LingTian1” album together—I hope you’ll like it!  

[previewyoutube=kY1Opi5mQB8;full][/previewyoutube]  
[code]  
LingTian1 Songs Playlist  
0:01 ♬ 01  Nice To Meet You  
1:40 ♬ 02  Take You into the Fang Palace  
4:00 ♬ 03  Destiny  
6:33 ♬ 04  Love Never Change  
9:57 ♬ 05  Listen to My Heart  
12:32 ♬ 06  Nice To Meet You (Eng ver.)  
14:04 ♬ 07  Nice To Meet You (Japanese ver.)  
15:21 ♬ 08  Nice To Meet You (Korean ver.)  
[/code]  

[previewyoutube=liFirhMrOvU;full][/previewyoutube]  
Song 1: “Nice to Meet You” (Chinese version)  
This song has a delightful melody and upbeat tempo. The lyrics sing ♪Nice to meet you, every moment I cherish; thank you for your smile, making my world more warm♪, expressing my love and gratitude for you.  

[previewyoutube=47k6w1owYDk;full][/previewyoutube]  
Song 2: “Take You Into The Fang Palace”  
This track was made especially for you because I hope you’ll come to the Fang Palace soon. I long to give you an abundant life, just like the lyric ♪I only wish your happiness beyond compare♪. I love the chorus—when I miss you, I hum ♪I want to take you into the Fang Palace♪.  

[previewyoutube=M40O7wRzZFQ;full][/previewyoutube]  
Song 3: “Destiny”  
♪When I was lost in the dark snowfield, your light illuminated my heart♪. This R&B‑style song thanks you for saving me in the snow. Your kindness and courage moved me deeply. The rhythm is gentle yet strong, with elegant, relaxed vocals. I originally thought this theme should be a grand symphony.  

[previewyoutube=CW4VbujQdsY;full][/previewyoutube]  
Song 4: “Love Never Change”  
♪You are the only one, irreplaceable; this love belongs to just you and me♪. Even if the arrangement feels a bit plain or outdated, this song conveys my sincere, unwavering love for you! I love it so much and want to tell you over and over how much I love you.  

[previewyoutube=IB7vEu3pY9A;full][/previewyoutube]  
Song 5: “Listen To My Heart”  
This song has a strong beat and powerful drums; the chorus melody is full of energy. Actually, this track isn’t exclusively mine—it’s a dance track from the 1000 Princes series that I perform with others. But since the lyrics are about me, I included it in my album. ♪Stop complaining to him; let me listen to your words♪  

[previewyoutube=chg_E7WQHx0;full][/previewyoutube]  
Song 6: “Nice to Meet You” (English version)  
This English version is derived from the first Chinese song. I especially love the male singer’s gentle, magnetic voice. The English lyrics beautifully convey my love with a fairy‑tale feel.  
♪Dance through the palace halls  
Glass slippers and a dream  
Midnight’s call won’t matter  
Together we will be♪  

[previewyoutube=PSMYZPseX9A;full][/previewyoutube]  
Song 7: “Nice to Meet You” (Japanese version)  
Also derived from the first track, you’ll hear similar yet varied main motifs—so enchanting.  
♪君に会えて / 本当に嬉しい / 君の恩に / 報いたい  
夜空の星が / 祝福するよ / 二人の未来 / 輝く道♪  
These poetic lyrics move me every time; I miss you deeply.  

[previewyoutube=Osm_drzseKo;full][/previewyoutube]  
Song 8: “Nice to Meet You” (Korean version)  
This Korean version is equally lovely!  
♪너와 나 함께해 / 이 밤이 끝나가도 / 은혜에 보답할게 / 너와 영원히♪  
You might wonder why one melody has so many language versions. I want to tell you about our future: when you enter the Fang Palace, we reunite and fall in love. You marry me and become the princess of Fang. You’ll attend many diplomatic events, so the royal court arranges foreign‑language lessons. We’ll visit foreign royal families, and you’ll hear songs in various languages!  

May you be surrounded by beautiful notes every day. Love you, kiss you~

notes.title: "LingTian1" v2.0 Fully Retranslated Version Released
notes.content:
[This Update Contents]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/1ab90b17800291e6213c49e67ebb40931117f78b.png[/img]
1. Full Foreign Language Texts Fully Re-translated
In the previous versions of "Ling Tian 1" Full Version and Demo, due to technical constraints, only machine translation could be used. In this update, AI translation has been fully implemented. The game scripts have been re-translated into 13 languages: English, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, French, Russian, Turkish, Thai, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Italian, and Portuguese. This makes the dialogue between you and the prince more fluent, the text expression clearer and more accurate, allowing the visual novel script to be better understood by players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/e951aee60d6d5170e43566d99be7b0d5ec1e9464.png[/img]
2. UI Update
After the player clicks on the icon of the Prince of Ling Tian waving at you on the right side, a quick panel with gold buttons will be displayed. The new update adds a [Settings] button to the quick panel, allowing players to conveniently adjust settings, including choosing languages, adjusting music and sound volumes, and controlling the dialogue speed.

3. SKIP Fast-Forward Function Improvement
In the old version, the fast-forward feature only allowed players to skip over the game script that had already been read. With this update, players can directly skip over content they haven't read yet, making it easier to browse quickly. However, selection buttons and mini-games cannot be skipped.

4. Game Level Improvement
In the previous versions of "Ling Tian 1" Full Version and Demo, some game levels required players to save the ongoing main storyline, go to other rooms of the prince to find clues and answers, then return to the main game to enter a password before continuing. This complex design made the game tedious. In the new version, the difficulty is reduced, allowing players to find answers without leaving the main storyline. 
This otome game, "Ling Tian 1," has undergone a comprehensive difficulty reduction. Previously, due to difficult password clues and answers, players couldn't pass the game and even thought it was a bug caused by poor developer skills. Therefore, changes have been made. The new version shows a "Give me a hint" or "Love cheat" button, allowing players to pass easily and enjoy the sweet and happy moments of falling in love with the Prince of Ling Tian while playing the game casually!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/5ae5dae8cdd31dd1e5b797a0a1a050bf3ecdb580.png[/img]
5. Name Input Box
The default name for the heroine, ABC123, can be modified in two ways, and names in various languages such as Thai can be entered in the text box. 
a. Click the red pencil on the homepage to directly modify the name, which will immediately display on the homepage.
b. Click the red silhouette of the girl on the homepage to display your name and points table. Click the red pencil to modify the name, but the new name will only appear after returning to the homepage.

notes.title: Developer's Log #1: Creating the "Soap Finding" Mini-Game for Ling Tian 1
notes.content:
[p]Hello, princesses! I’m Ginyan, the independent developer of Ling Tian 1 and the 1000 Princes series. In this video, I want to share my thoughts as a beginner developer while making the "Find the Soap" mini-game in Ling Tian 1.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/b0fa42ad909c2c23db2983a60836c8f2f34cab5d.jpg"][/img]
"Find the Soap" is a mini-game in my otome game Ling Tian 1. When players enter the bathroom, Prince Ling Tian needs your help to find his green soap. The inspiration for this mini-game came from an interview with a soldier I read, where he said that he could live with just one soap to bathe. I thought that even though Ling Tian is a prince, as a military academy student, he still maintains a soldier's simple and humble lifestyle.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/712836a05ab7f2c4209a506383c06027092da8d3.gif"][/img]
The Baroque-style bathroom background was generated by MidJourney, and the soap was generated by Meshy. I wanted to use the gorgeous and elegant bathroom decor to give players the romantic atmosphere typical of otome games, and the prince’s white bathrobe matches the bathroom setting. Right now, the prince is holding a green mint soap, which is the soap given to every student at the military academy.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/bed64a6d68dad810a0c2a4a520c22844bb4a748c.gif"][/img]
Actually, I always use yellow sulfur soap when I bathe, so I considered generating yellow soap with AI. I have oily skin, and sulfur soap is great for disinfecting and relieving itching. Also, sulfur is an ingredient in fireworks during the Chinese New Year, which can kill germs. A fortune teller once told me that if you encounter a ghost, using sulfur soap can drive away evil spirits. However, for the search mini-game, I had to use the mint green color of the soap to create a visual confusion with the emerald green color of the bathroom decor, increasing the difficulty for players. So, the soap had to be green.

The key code for finding the soap is to make the soap appear randomly within the screen area. The player finds and clicks the soap, making it disappear. The following code is the core; for programming experts, it's very simple, but for me as an independent developer with limited programming skills, this code took a lot of thinking and testing before I figured it out. First, I used x and y to specify the soap's coordinates within the area, and the values for x and y are random, using the keyword Random. The soap is also designed as a button, so I need to use the button parameter. The "Find the Soap" game keeps repeating until the player has clicked the soap five times.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/9bb3ec7fc84b4dfd18c2c56e438a0d5857584a4e.gif"][/img]
I adjusted the soap size repeatedly. If the button is too big, it’s too easy to find; if it’s too small, players won’t be able to see it on a small screen. During testing, there were times when I was so dizzy that I couldn't find the soap myself. In those situations, I used Scene Assistant (coordinate helper) to cheat and move the soap to see where it was.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/18f14a0e034e2687ecb5e7eeb568feb325e9b20f.gif"][/img] By the way, why does the word "gecko" appear in my code? Because at first, I actually designed the game to find a gecko in the bathroom, but the gecko's shape was too obvious and easy to find, so I changed it to a more difficult-to-find soap. However, I kept the original code and just replaced the image with the soap. The gecko element is, of course, inspired by my experience living in Turtle Country. (Turtle Country is a new country established after World War III, where Thai is the official language. It’s part of the world of the 1000 Princes series.) When I first arrived in Turtle Country, I used to scream in fear when I saw a gecko in the bathroom. But now, when I see a gecko stuck on the bathroom wall, I just greet it and say, "Alright, stop spying on me while I bathe and go play my game!" [/p]

notes.title: A Love Letter to You: "I Am Your Destined Love" – Free eBook!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/a0dfa7229891ec9ee90a1957105bd7ab62505425.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/53c941a4e35d19cb053dd8a49b9f71e1570f791e.jpg[/img]

My Dearest You,

Hello! My name is Ling Tian. This is a love letter I wrote for you. Although you don’t know me well, I have already fallen deeply in love with you. Half a month ago, you saved my life in the snow, and I am immensely grateful to you. Thank you for contacting the rescue team and staying with me while we waited for the helicopter. My wounds have just healed recently, and I wanted to personally thank you with a gift, but I didn’t expect so many misunderstandings between us.

I must repay your kindness and generosity, so at the end of this letter, I have attached a large check for you. Please fill in your name. Previously, I tried to transfer money to you, but due to the large amount, your bank account was mistakenly flagged for money laundering and got frozen. I deeply apologize for the trouble it caused. That’s why I have also attached my bank card at the end of this letter—feel free to use it.

You said you are just an ordinary girl, studying at a culinary academy and working part-time at a braised pork rice restaurant. You said you cannot be friends with a prince. So now, I seriously ask you—if we can’t be friends, how about being lovers instead? I want to be with you with marriage in mind. Will you be my girlfriend, be my princess?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/df219e587c143ffe99008b1d3930aedc87baa2e6.jpg[/img]

You’ve heard from rebel sources that I suffer from a pituitary growth hormone deficiency, that I am a hideous dwarf only 125 cm tall, and that my IQ is below 50. If that were true, I wouldn’t be studying at the Asian Military Academy right now. If you choose to be with me, you will discover who I really am.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/f3bd2e5d1c4ba05229dc77c3245e70a1a0374a72.jpg[/img]

This love letter is handwritten by me, and my royal secretary helped design it to be more formal and exquisite. I also included many little puzzles throughout the letter because I heard you like solving puzzle books with Cheng Xun. That made me so jealous I almost went crazy.

Now, as you read this letter, you are reading my heart. I want to convey all my feelings to you, without reservation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/840163facf7c68043687999404b7e24af106bba2.jpg[/img]

I am forever grateful that you saved me, but because of that, the people who originally wanted me dead have now set their sights on you. You said you've recently received anonymous threats, which worries me deeply. I feel guilty that you are now involved. Their threats against you have completely enraged me. The only thing I can do is protect you at all costs—I won’t let anything harm you.

I want to arrange bodyguards for you, but what I want most is to be your boyfriend, your protector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/aec93208208db8a6f54d0ba921452a1895d466b8.jpg[/img]

If anything unexpected happens, whether it’s hand-to-hand combat or armed confrontation, I can keep you safe.

From today onward, I will pick you up after school or work, and you will be with me. Let me protect you every moment, keeping you safe from any threats or attacks.

I am driving over right now—see you soon!

Fang Ling Tian

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/45e2e5de331a91f6a8bf29c97535f38d692d3512.jpg[/img]

About the eBook
This book is the setting collection for the otome game "Ling Tian 1", including world-building, background, characters, and story details. Unlike a typical game setting book, this is presented as a love letter written for you.

[code]Currently, "Ling Tian 1 ~ I Am Your Destined Love" is available in Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese. You can download it for free on Google Play Books. Search for the keyword "ginyan" in Google Play Books to find these eBooks.[/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/840163facf7c68043687999404b7e24af106bba2.jpg[/img]

Love Letter Table of Contents
Holding You Close – This is my love letter to you. Will you be my girlfriend, my princess?
Meeting You – Do you still remember the first time we met?

Missing You – Singing for you

Special explanation of 3 gestures:
① The gesture with the index and middle fingers intertwined represents good luck, wishing you good fortune. The green four-leaf clover behind me is a lucky clover for you. It is said that if you find the rare four-leaf clover among the common three-leaf clovers, you will receive good luck. Sometimes, it is interpreted as a prayer for God's protection.

② "Great luck and prosperity," in Chinese, the word for orange sounds like the word for good luck, "Ji." Also, oranges are a popular gift during the Spring Festival in the Fang Kingdom when they are in season. Ripe oranges are sweet and juicy, symbolizing a sweet and happy life. I send you oranges, wishing you all the best in everything. The prayer gesture with both hands folded is also a request for the Buddha's blessing, and in the country of turtles that speaks Thai, it is a greeting gesture.

③ Both hands making the "phone" gesture simultaneously is the Shaka sign in oceanic cultures. It can be used as a casual greeting, to show thanks, goodwill, or to say goodbye. However, I interpret this gesture as an invitation for a date!

notes.title: [Kiss you] Guess what gift I’ve prepared for you? Happy Candy Tree Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/d763058df6af7eaae6556601fac04c0366201f1d.jpg[/img]

I cannot express how happy I am to spend this special Candy Tree Festival with you! I specifically instructed my royal secretary not to decorate all the green trees in Fang Palace. I left this one tree untouched, so we could decorate it together with colorful candies and chocolates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/9e10bbf1d3eab8bace1219d68fa86fee3c35a129.jpg[/img]

Watching you climb high up the ladder to hang the lights on the tree made me nervous. I couldn’t help but gently hold your waist and lift you off the ladder carefully. Let me hang the lights instead—I wouldn’t want you to be in danger. I’d be worried.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/cbdf63e711a75f119c83a114ff8399806b1ba2ae.jpg[/img]

I’m so glad we made so many gingerbread men today. When we kneaded the dough together, my hands wrapped around yours, pressing the dough together. I felt a warm sense of happiness filling my heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/173d724162535285a79e38e1ff31f2f293bd0780.jpg[/img]

Taking the gingerbread men out of the oven together was such an exciting moment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/3a18b8ba2a8245d6c004d149f71ad7fc58fd187a.jpg[/img]

When I brought out this enormous gingerbread giant, your jaw dropped in surprise!

[h3][b]◆ Mini-Game | Find the Gingerbread Man[/b][/h3]

Now, let’s play a little game! Can you find the gingerbread man in the box that looks exactly like the one next to me?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/7cf27e69de2e0c35f862a728f8677cad0516ec48.jpg[/img]

I know you’ll find it—just like how fate destined us to meet.

[h3][b]◆ Special Gift | Guess What It Is?[/b][/h3]

You even brought me a gift—how thoughtful of you! Your presence alone is the best gift heaven could give me. Thank you for saving me in the snow. To celebrate the Candy Tree Festival, let me give you this special gift.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/4e672aef805c9898698201e371be0b12f68d895d.jpg[/img]

Can you guess what this is? This red heart-shaped item has two long, white ears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/ea0a479e9b884c35205e3a7082ebe0bb46aa3ca3.jpg[/img]

Here’s a hint: the items in my hands are part of a set. They’re both for you! Can you figure out what it is? (Answer below!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/4e672aef805c9898698201e371be0b12f68d895d.jpg[/img]

Take a look! The items I’m holding in my hands are a pair, both for you. Have you guessed what it is yet? (The answer is at the bottom.)

[h3][b]◆ Song | Happy Candy Tree Festival![/b][/h3]

Let’s listen to the Candy Tree Festival song together. This song was specially created for you.

[previewyoutube=U5mLoLxexh4;full][/previewyoutube]

**Lyrics Overview:**  
In the Candy Tree Festival, love is the sweetest thing.  
Your smile brings joy like no other gift can.  
You’re a treasure sent from heaven, the perfect melody in my heart.  
In this sugary dream world, it’s just you and me.

[h3][b]◆ Traditional Feast | Let’s Eat Roast Suckling Pig![/b][/h3]

You must be hungry by now. Let’s head to the restaurant to enjoy the Candy Tree Festival’s roast suckling pig! It’s a traditional dish with a long history in the Kingdom of Fang. In traditional Chinese culture, roast suckling pig is often used as an offering to gods or ancestors to express gratitude and pray for peace and happiness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/aacf999f4eec5a5b212b1f66ff61c9d13807a495.jpg[/img]

Look at the pig's golden-brown skin and its perfect, complete form—it symbolizes family and national prosperity. That’s why we eat it during major festivals and celebrations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/ce2dfdd142cba71c5fd23719be8306dfcd7369dc.jpg[/img]

The Candy Tree Festival is also a joyful time of harvest. Let’s enjoy this delicious roast suckling pig together! Just focus on eating—I’ll carve the meat for you. Isn’t it tasty?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/d07252fb2b2a20e2f769296a1af730d22c519cea.jpg[/img]

[code]Answer to the Riddles:  
1. The correct gingerbread man is in the second row, first from the left: blue eyes, white mouth, orange buttons.  
2. The gift I gave you is a pair of couple’s gloves. Since you saved me in the snow and gave me your red scarf, I’m giving you matching red gloves. The heart-shaped knitted item is a large mitten we can share. Each of us can slip our hands in through the white openings, letting us hold hands without barriers. Of course, there’s also a separate red glove for each of us.[/code]

notes.title: [Help you] Can’t find the emergency number in Chapter 4? Let me help!
notes.content:

To my dear you:I am Ling Tian. You said you can’t find the emergency phone number in Chapter 4? Let me help you!Because you like otome games, I entrusted the developer to develop it. I want to make you happy. I never wanted to embarrass you. I heard from you that you are stuck in Chapter 4. You can't find the emergency number and the number you entered is wrong. Because I set up obstacles for you, I am very angry and blame myself. I want to beat the developer. Why should I embarrass my princess?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/e276de29808c4451da2a12bff4a1ca515aa97b26.jpg[/img]
If you want to know the number, please come into the living room now and chat with me on your mobile phone

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/9221a6abf477ac6afba6b000bfb5734fa9b13e5f.jpg[/img]
You'll find the answer in our chat messages

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/70cb0606489a21a766a4d43d8dd2e4aad137e9f6.jpg[/img]
What I want to tell you is that there will be some puzzles in this game. If you encounter difficulties, please enter my study room to read my diary, go to my living room to chat with me on my mobile phone, and call me in the bedroom. Then you will find clues to these questions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/f6a43e102563a1ba8789018cd8b3280b6e62305d.jpg[/img]
It is now the depth of winter, the weather is cold and freezing, and after several heavy snowfalls, Fang Country is also covered in white snow and silver. Winter is my favorite season, because the first time I met you was in winter, and I met my most beloved you on such a snowy day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/31bcc0577f5e5108e0eea453ada9a48ff44b9d99.jpg[/img]
still clearly remember that when you were in the snow, you threw snowballs at me, and you found me later. Now all my injuries are healed, because as long as I see you, I will recover quickly. So let's go on a date tomorrow. How about going to build a snowman in the snow together? You can make small snowballs to hit me again! I'm so looking forward to being fucked by you! You are as soft and gentle as little snowflakes when you hit me, so comfortable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/a7b3d24826a3a94d9bd0d205246b0e19e70d8600.jpg[/img]
The temperature is below freezing. Please keep yourself warm and don't catch a cold. I'll be worried about you. As a girl, isn’t it easy for your hands and feet to get cold in winter? When we meet tomorrow, put your hand on my hot abdomen and let my warm abdominal muscles warm you. Let me hug you, warm you, and protect you!
